```{r, include=FALSE}
library(highcharter)
hc_set_theme("hcrt", tooltip = list(valueDecimals = 2))
options(highcharter.google_fonts = FALSE)
```

`highchart(type = "stock")` adds the Stock navigator and range selector.
Use `highchartstock()` when readers also need drawing tools and technical
indicators. The introductory examples use the xts package's sample OHLC matrix;
the closing dashboard restores the SPY example with a local historical snapshot.

```{r}
data(sample_matrix, package = "xts")
prices <- xts::as.xts(sample_matrix)
hchart(prices, id = "price", name = "Sample instrument")
```

## Lines and price bars

One ordinary column produces a line. All four price fields together produce candles.
Use `type = "ohlc"` for open–high–low–close bars.

```{r}
hchart(prices[, "Close"], name = "Close")
hchart(prices, type = "ohlc", name = "Sample instrument")
```

## Flags, navigator and indicators

The flag and moving average select the price series by ID. The range selector
and navigator act on the same time axis. Open the Stock Tools toolbar to add
an indicator interactively.

```{r}
price_chart <- highchartstock() |>
  hc_add_series(prices, name = "Price", id = "price") |>
  hc_add_series(
    type = "sma",
    linkedTo = "price",
    name = "10-day mean",
    params = list(period = 10)
  ) |>
  hc_add_series(
    type = "flags",
    onSeries = "price",
    data = list(
      list(
        x = datetime_to_timestamp(time(prices)[30]),
        title = "A",
        text = "Day 30"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  hc_stockTools(
    gui = list(
      enabled = TRUE,
      buttons = c("indicators", "zoomChange", "fullScreen")
    )
  ) |>
  hc_navigator(enabled = TRUE)

price_chart
```

## Two stacked panels

The price and the daily trading range have separate scales. Their heights are
in the ratio 3 to 1. The panels share the time axis.

```{r}
daily_range <- prices[, "High"] - prices[, "Low"]
highchart(type = "stock") |>
  hc_yAxis(create_axis(2, heights = c(3, 1))) |>
  hc_add_series(prices, name = "Price", yAxis = 0) |>
  hc_add_series(
    daily_range,
    name = "High minus low",
    type = "column",
    yAxis = 1
  )
```

## Update a series and its visible range in Shiny

Run the app below, then press **Update**. The stock widget stays mounted while
the proxy changes the selected series and the x-axis range. Redraw the updated
series before setting the range so the Stock navigator has its new data limits.

```{r stock-proxy, eval=FALSE, code=readLines(system.file("examples", "stock-proxy.R", package="highcharter"))}
```

## Price, moving averages, volume and momentum

The earlier advanced example combined SPY prices, two moving averages, trading
volume and RSI, including its 30/70 guide levels. This version uses a local
snapshot of 2025 daily prices from Yahoo Finance, so rendering does not depend
on a live quote request. `adjustOHLC()` adjusts the price fields using the
downloaded adjusted close; volume remains the reported daily volume.

```{r stock-dashboard}
snapshot <- read.csv(system.file(
  "extdata",
  "spy-2025.csv",
  package = "highcharter"
))
SPY <- xts::xts(snapshot[-1], order.by = base::as.Date(snapshot$date))
SPY <- quantmod::adjustOHLC(SPY, use.Adjusted = TRUE)
close <- quantmod::Cl(SPY)
fast_mean <- TTR::SMA(close, n = 5)
slow_mean <- TTR::SMA(close, n = 100)
momentum <- TTR::RSI(close, n = 14)
sell_level <- xts::xts(rep(70, NROW(SPY)), order.by = time(SPY))
buy_level <- xts::xts(rep(30, NROW(SPY)), order.by = time(SPY))

highchart(type = "stock") |>
  hc_rangeSelector(selected = 1) |>
  hc_title(text = "SPY: price, volume and momentum in 2025") |>
  hc_yAxis(create_axis(3, heights = c(3, 1, 1), turnopposite = TRUE)) |>
  hc_add_series(SPY, yAxis = 0, name = "SPY", id = "instrument") |>
  hc_add_series(fast_mean, yAxis = 0, name = "5-day mean") |>
  hc_add_series(slow_mean, yAxis = 0, name = "100-day mean") |>
  hc_add_series(
    quantmod::Vo(SPY),
    yAxis = 1,
    name = "Volume",
    type = "column"
  ) |>
  hc_add_series(momentum, yAxis = 2, name = "RSI (14)") |>
  hc_add_series(
    sell_level,
    yAxis = 2,
    name = "RSI 70",
    dashStyle = "ShortDash",
    color = "#94A3B8",
    lineWidth = 1,
    showInLegend = FALSE,
    enableMouseTracking = FALSE
  ) |>
  hc_add_series(
    buy_level,
    yAxis = 2,
    name = "RSI 30",
    dashStyle = "ShortDash",
    color = "#94A3B8",
    lineWidth = 1,
    showInLegend = FALSE,
    enableMouseTracking = FALSE
  ) |>
  hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "Price")) |>
  hc_tooltip(valueDecimals = 2, shared = TRUE) |>
  hc_size(height = 720)
```
